comment: end.c save_killers() and restore_killers(), from save.c savegamestate():293 and restore.c restgamestate():653. A debug-mode Samurai wishes for a cockatrice egg and eats it, so eat.c sets the delayed STONED killer "cockatrice egg", then saves. The second segment restores, waits until timeout.c stoned_dialogue() finishes her, and dismisses the end-of-game prompts; the tombstone reads "petrified by a cockatrice egg" only if the delayed killer survived the save. !safe_wait lets 's' pass while Stoned. Seed, clock, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
